title: Former Shin Bet Chief Ronen Bar Sues Netanyahu Over October 7 Claims
detail: France 24 reports that Israel's former security chief has sued Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over his claims about October 7. The suit follows Ronen Bar's September 28 statement that he would sue Netanyahu over allegations that he withheld warnings before the attack. The report gives only a headline summary, so details of the claims and the court filing are not yet confirmed.
